distinct_fact_and_source: The angle is the album personnel: Paper Walls is the last Yellowcard record with Peter Mosely on bass and the first with Ryan Mendez on guitar. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paper_Walls. This is not the same fact as the song's chart history, the single's B side or the band's formation, which other packages use.
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other long-form package, checked with the gate and separately against the whole accessible copy corpus. Tag lists are excluded because the channel's tag tail is standardised, and the Short side is excluded as a mirror because it carries mandated pointer wording. One rewrite was needed, on the call-to-action lines, which collided with the X-Kid package. The only remaining overlap anywhere is the functional phrase 'the related video on this Short', which is the required pointer and not stylistic reuse.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: The upload length is unknown, so no duration appears anywhere in the copy and the video is never described as the album edit. No screenshots exist for this upload, so no live state is recorded. The studio question was removed as a quiz because the description already names Ocean Studios in Burbank; the quiz now asks the album's Billboard 200 position, which is not printed. The chart figure belongs to the album, not the song, and is described that way. The Short side of the pair carries a mandated pointer to this long form at the top of its pin and as a description block, per Short_Full_Recording_Rule.md, and neither package now describes the Short as a cut, a trim or a separate recording, because both are one performance captured horizontally and vertically at the same time.
